items.source: Head on over to start.spring.io and select the AI Models and Vector Stores that you want to use in your new applications.
items.translation: 前往 start.spring.io，并在您的新应用中选择所需的 AI 模型和向量存储。

items.source: To use the latest development versions (e.g. 2.0.0-SNAPSHOT), you need to add the following snapshot repositories in your build file.

items.source: The Spring AI Bill of Materials (BOM) declares the recommended versions of all the dependencies used by a given release of Spring AI. This is a BOM-only version and it just contains dependency management and no plugin declarations or direct references to Spring or Spring Boot. You can use the Spring Boot parent POM, or use the BOM from Spring Boot (spring-boot-dependencies) to manage Spring Boot versions.
items.translation: Spring AI 物料清单（BOM）声明了给定版本的 Spring AI 所使用的所有依赖项的推荐版本。 这是一个仅包含 BOM 的版本，仅提供依赖管理功能，不包含插件声明或对 Spring 或 Spring Boot 的直接引用。 您可以使用 Spring Boot 父 POM，或使用来自 Spring Boot 的 BOM（spring-boot-dependencies）来管理 Spring Boot 版本。

items.source: This section offers jumping off points for how to get started using Spring AI.
items.translation: 本节提供了使用 Spring AI 的入门指引。

items.source: You should follow the steps in each of the following sections according to your needs.
items.translation: 您应根据需要遵循以下各部分中的步骤。

items.source:
Spring AI artifacts are available in Maven Central.
No additional repository configuration is required. Just make sure you have Maven Central enabled in your build file.
items.translation: Spring AI 的构件可在 Maven Central 获取。无需进行额外的仓库配置，只需确保您的构建文件中已启用 Maven Central 即可。

items.source: Add the following repository definitions to your Maven or Gradle build file:
items.translation: 将以下仓库定义添加到您的 Maven 或 Gradle 构建文件中：

items.source: This configuration allows Maven to access Spring snapshot repositories directly while still using your mirror for other dependencies.
items.translation: 此配置允许 Maven 直接访问 Spring 快照仓库，同时仍使用您的镜像来获取其他依赖项。

items.source: Add the BOM to your project:
items.translation: 将物料清单（BOM）添加到您的项目中：

items.source: Gradle users can also use the Spring AI BOM by leveraging Gradle native support for declaring dependency constraints using a Maven BOM. This is implemented by adding a 'platform' dependency handler method to the dependencies section of your Gradle build script.
items.translation: Gradle 用户还可以通过利用 Gradle 原生的 Maven BOM 依赖约束声明支持，来使用 Spring AI BOM。这通过在 Gradle 构建脚本的 dependencies 部分添加一个 'platform' 依赖处理程序方法来实现。

items.source: Each of the following sections in the documentation shows which dependencies you need to add to your project build system.
items.translation: 文档中的每个部分都展示了您需要添加到项目构建系统中的依赖项。
